ui_bugs.issue: FIXED. TogetherTab destructured only {home, reload, initialAction} but its JSX referenced playSession/playRef (line 284) which are passed by the parent SocialPage (line 64). After fix: modal opens, session creation succeeds, referral deep-link works, +500 points confirmed on joiner (points pill 502 -> 1,002).

critical_code_review_comments: P0 crash root cause was a simple destructure omission introduced when playSession/playRef were plumbed through from SocialPage to TogetherTab. React should have flagged the undefined identifier at build time only if ESLint no-undef was strict — DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true in /app/frontend/.env suppresses this class of error. Consider re-enabling ESLint (or at least a CI lint gate) so future missing-prop references fail loud instead of only at runtime inside an error boundary.
PlayTogetherModal (SocialTogether.jsx:506+) correctly wires sessionId/refId props for the referral deep-link — auto-open + auto-join flow verified end-to-end.
Shop Together <Check> import (SocialTogether.jsx:10) is now present and correctly used on both cart-mine-paid (line 744) and per-item PAID chip (line 706). Crash regressed cleanly.

Backend referral logic (routes/social_together.py:503-539): host-fallback referrer only fires when joiner is in the explicit invitees list — matches spec. play_referrals collection acts as the idempotency key (dup insert raises Exception -> reward:null on rejoin). PointsService.award is also keyed by (source, source_id, idempotency_key) so points cannot double-award even if the referral doc is re-inserted.

rca of the issue: P0 web regression `ReferenceError: playSession is not defined` at TogetherTab. Reproduction: log in as any authenticated user on web -> /social -> click 'Play Together' pillar (social-do-play). Immediately, React throws inside the ternary render of `playOpen && <PlayTogetherModal sessionId={playSession} refId={playRef} />` because `playSession` and `playRef` are unresolved identifiers in TogetherTab's scope (SocialV2.jsx:138 destructure omitted them, but the parent at line 64 does pass qSession/qRef via props named playSession/playRef). React error boundary catches -> the whole Together tab replaced with 'Something went wrong'. Mitigation applied: added `playSession, playRef` to the destructure at /app/frontend/src/pages/social/SocialV2.jsx:138. After hot-reload, Play Together modal opens, friend chips render, play-create succeeds, share buttons all render, and the referral deep-link auto-join grants +500 pts to the joiner (verified visually via points pill jump 502 -> 1,002 as freeuser).
